subject: Transportation Systems
title: Data-Driven Transit Planning
description: Learn Data-Driven Transit Planning in one minute.

hook.text: Transit agencies once planned routes by intuition. Now they use anonymized phone data to see where people actually go.

buildup.text: Aggregated cell phone movement data shows real travel patterns—origin, destination, time of day.

discovery.text: This data reveals unserved demand. A neighborhood generating thousands of trips may have no bus route.

twist.text: Privacy concerns are real. Even anonymized data can sometimes be re-identified with enough cross-referencing.

climax.text: Agencies that use data well redesign networks to match actual demand. Ridership rises without adding cost.

punchline.text: The best transit route is the one people are already traveling.

quiz.question: How does cell phone data help transit planning?
options: It reveals real travel patterns showing where demand exists
